column1: # Design-space catalog: one row per synthesis campaign group.
# This replaces the per-group files under configs/model_sweeps/. Each row is
# rendered back to that JSON schema by slurm/sweeplib/sweep_spec.py, so the
# model generator is unchanged and the stem numbering is unchanged with it.
# DO NOT MERGE ROWS. A design's stem is dense_{N}l_{idx} where idx is its
# position in the cartesian product of these columns; folding two rows together
# (say the 4,8,12 and 6,10,14 bitwidth groups) renumbers every stem and breaks
# the (run, stem) join keys the shared archive, sample_lhs_from_archive.py and
# run_rerun_from_archive.sh all rely on. Add a row instead.
# input, layers  size ranges as lb-ub, expanded to the powers of two inside them.
#                layers is one range per dense layer, in order.
# acts           activation order matters: it is the mask position, not a set.
# mode           cartesian    enumerated from the columns
#                lhs_nlayer   Latin hypercube over the columns, single seed=42 draw
#                cart_sz128   cartesian, keeping only designs with a dim of 128
#                archive_lhs  sampled from the 45nm archive, re-synthesised in GF22
# candidates     for the sampled modes, the frozen design list under
# legacy         the configs/model_sweeps/ file this row replaces, and the key
